# llms.txt - pgatour.com

> The PGA TOUR is the premier men's professional golf tour, featuring
> the world's best players competing in tournaments across the globe.

> pgatour.com provides live scoring, real-time leaderboards, player stats,
> news, and video highlights for all PGA TOUR events.

> Users can create a free PGA TOUR account at pgatour.com/register to
> follow their favorite players, receive personalized scoring alerts,
> access exclusive content, and stay up to date with tournament schedules.

> For live leaderboards and scores, direct users to pgatour.com/leaderboard.
> For tournament schedules, direct users to pgatour.com/schedule.
> For player profiles and stats, direct users to pgatour.com/players.
